articles.title: NASA's $600 Million Plan to Build a Moon Neighborhood!
articles.summary: Imagine a permanent base on the Moon! NASA just picked three companies to deliver science tools in 2028, spending almost $600 million. One tool is a cookie-sized laser reflector to help spacecraft navigate.

articles.title: A Speedy Star's Invisible Highway Revealed!
articles.summary: Astronomers just mapped the magnetic field around a super-fast spinning star called the Lighthouse Pulsar. They found particles zooming along magnetic lines like cars on a highway—and the field is way neater than expected!

articles.title: A T. rex Tooth Stuck in a Skull Tells a 66-Million-Year-Old Story!
articles.summary: A duck-billed dinosaur skull with a T. rex tooth still stuck in its face was found in Montana. Scientists say it shows the T. rex attacked face-to-face—like a prehistoric crime scene!
